rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for being unaffected or not influenced, including by an effect such as ageing.

example.english: Even when people criticize them, they are impervious to it.
example.traditional: 就算人哋點批評，佢都唔受影響。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 jan4 dei6 dim2 pai1 ping4 keoi5 dou1 m4 sau6 jing2 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this specifically for materials, clothing, roofs, or containers that do not let water through.

example.english: This jacket is impervious to water, so there is no need to worry in heavy rain.
example.traditional: 呢件外套係防水，落大雨都唔使驚。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 hai6 fong4 seoi2 lok6 daai6 jyu5 dou1 m4 sai2 geng1

rows.note: Use this when something stays serviceable despite physical wear and tear or prolonged use.

example.english: This phone is really impervious to wear and tear—it is still working after years of use.
example.traditional: 呢部電話真係襟用，用咗幾年都仲冇壞。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 kam1 jung6 jung6 zo2 gei2 nin4 dou1 zung6 mou5 waai6
